stem:
What is the difference between asteroids and comets?
1. Asteroids are small rocky planetoids, while comets are formed of frozen gases held together by rocky and metallic material.
2. Asteroids are found mostly between the orbits of Jupiter and Mars, while comets are found mostly between Venus and Mercury.
3. Comets show a perceptible glowing tail, while asteroids do not.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
expl: Asteroids are generally considered to be made up of metals and rocky material, while comets are made up of ice, dust and rocky material. Asteroids are found much closer to the Sun. Comets are formed farther from the Sun in the ‘Kuiper Belt’ and Oort Cloud. Comets sprout tails when they approach the Sun. Asteroids typically remain much more solid and self-contained even when near the Sun.
